63875-red-witch-of-mercury.title: Red Witch Of Mercury
63875-red-witch-of-mercury.creator: Unknown
63875-red-witch-of-mercury.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The night was very hot; but then it is always hot on Mercury, the newest, the wildest, the hottest of Earth's frontiers. Fans spaced about the garden's walls sluggishly stirred the night air, while the men and women sitting at the tables drank heavily of Latonka, the pale green wine of Mercury. Only the native waiters, the enigmatic, yellow-eyed Mercurians, seemed unaffected by the heat. They didn't sweat at all.

arxiv-1507-05405.title: Remarks on Contact and Jacobi Geometry
arxiv-1507-05405.creator: Andrew James BRUCE †, Katarzyna GRABOWSKA ‡ and Janusz GRABOWSKI §
arxiv-1507-05405.description: Abstract We present an approach to Jacobi and contact geometry that makes many facts, presented in the literature in an overcomplicated way, much more natural and clear. The key concepts are Kirillov manifolds and linear Kirillov structures , i.e., homogeneous Poisson manifolds and, respectively, homogeneous linear Poisson manifolds.

arxiv-2109-06605.title: mDAPT : Multilingual Domain Adaptive Pretraining in a Single Model
arxiv-2109-06605.creator: Rasmus Kær Jørgensen, Mareike Hartmann, Xiang Dai, Desmond Elliott
arxiv-2109-06605.description: Abstract Domain adaptive pretraining, i.e. the continued unsupervised pretraining of a language model on domain-specific text, improves the modelling of text for downstream tasks within the domain. Numerous real-world applications are based on domain-specific text, e.g. working with financial or biomedical documents, and these applications often need to support multiple languages.

arxiv-2309-01080.title: Quantum geometric formulation of Brans-Dicke theory for Bianchi I spacetime
arxiv-2309-01080.creator: Manabendra Sharma, Gustavo S. Vicente, Leila L. Graef, Rudnei O. Ramos, Anzhong Wang
arxiv-2309-01080.description: Abstract This paper investigates Bianchi I spacetimes within the Jordan frame of Brans-Dicke theory, incorporating the framework of effective loop quantum gravity. After developing general formulas, we analyze the robustness of classical singularity resolution due to quantum geometric effects using two common quantization schemes. We then compare the resulting physical properties.

arxiv-2411-04186.title: Cosmic (super)strings with a time-varying tension
arxiv-2411-04186.creator: Filippo Revello a,b and Gonzalo Villa c
arxiv-2411-04186.description: Abstract Cosmic (super)strings offer promising ways to test ideas about the early universe and physics at high energies. While in field theory constructions their tension is usually assumed to be constant (or at most slowly-varying), this is often not the case in the context of String Theory.

pmc-10663259.title: A Phase 1b/2 Study of Alpelisib in Combination with Cetuximab in Patients with Recurrent or Metastatic Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma
pmc-10663259.creator: Albiruni R. Abdul Razak, Hung-Ming Wang, Jang-Yang Chang, Myung-Ju Ahn, Pamela Munster, George Blumenschein, Benjamin Solomon, Darren Wan-Teck Lim, Ruey-Long Hong, David Pfister, Nabil F. Saba, Se-Hoon Lee, Carla van Herpen, Cornelia Quadt, Douglas Bootle, Lars Blumenstein, David Demanse, Jean-Pierr
pmc-10663259.description: BackgroundAlpelisib in combination with cetuximab showed synergistic anti-tumour activity in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) models.ObjectivesThe recommended phase 2 dose (RP2D) was determined in a phase 1b dose-escalation study. Phase 2 evaluated anti-tumour activity with a randomised part in cetuximab-naïve patients and a non-randomised part in cetuximab-resistant patients.

pmc-10670909.title: The Influence of Sleep Disorders on Neurobiological Structures and Cognitive Processes in Pediatric Population with ASD and Epilepsy: A Systematic Review
pmc-10670909.creator: Miguel López-Zamora, Alejandro Cano-Villagrasa, Antonio Cortés-Ramos, Nadia Porcar-Gozalbo, María del Mar Molero Juradoe
pmc-10670909.description: Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) and epilepsy are increasingly prevalent comorbidities in our society. These two disorders are often accompanied by other comorbidities, such as sleep disorders, significantly impacting the quality of life of individuals with ASD and epilepsy. To date, clinical approaches have primarily been descriptive in nature.

pmc-11512989.title: The pluripotent-to-totipotent state transition in mESCs activates the intrinsic apoptotic pathway through DUX-induced DNA replication stress
pmc-11512989.creator: Shunze Jia, Xinpeng Wen, Minwei Zhu, Xudong Fu
pmc-11512989.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The pluripotent mouse embryonic stem cell (mESCs) can transit into the totipotent-like state, and the transcription factor DUX is one of the master regulators of this transition. Intriguingly, this transition in mESCs is accompanied by massive cell death, which significantly impedes the establishment and maintenance of totipotent cells in vitro, yet the underlying mechanisms of this cell death remain largely elusive. In this study, we found that the totipotency transition in mESCs triggered cell death through the upregulation of DUX.

pmc-11649706.title: Circulating tumor DNA as a predictive biomarker for treatment response and survival in metastatic colorectal cancer
pmc-11649706.creator: Mengying Kou, Ying Deng
pmc-11649706.description: PurposeTo explore the potential of circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) as a prognostic biomarker to predict treatment response and survival outcomes in patients with metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC).MethodsA retrospective analysis was conducted on 134 patients with mCRC who were treated between January 2020 and December 2021. The patients were classified into ctDNA-negative and ctDNA-positive groups based on plasma ctDNA detection.

pmc-12578223.title: Robust adaptive control with lumped model uncertainty and wind disturbance estimation for airship trajectory tracking
pmc-12578223.creator: Muhammad Wasim, Ahsan Ali, Faisal Saleem, Inam Ul Hasan Shaikh, Jamshed Iqbal
pmc-12578223.description: The robotic airship can be used as an aerostatic platform for many potential applications, for example, communication, hovering payload deliveries, data-gathering for research studies, etc. These applications require a fully autonomous perspective of an airship. One of the important aspects of airship autonomy is trajectory tracking control.

pmc-12612770.title: What are the exercise barriers, facilitators and preferences of community-dwelling older adults with heart failure with preserved ejection fraction? A qualitative best fit framework analysis
pmc-12612770.creator: Faye Forsyth, Peter Hartley, Jonathan Mant, Scott Rowbotham, John Sharpley, Alison Wood, Christi Deaton
pmc-12612770.description: AbstractObjectivesTo establish, through patient and public involvement (PPI) events, the exercise barriers, facilitators and preferences of people with heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF).DesignQualitative ‘best fit’ framework analysis was used to analyse field notes and transcripts collected during three patient and public involvement meetings and three workshops.

pmc-12635654.title: Heart rate variability associated with depression and lung decline in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease: Mechanisms and interventions
pmc-12635654.creator: Mei-He Liu, Li-Li Wu
pmc-12635654.description: In this article, we comment on the study by Yang et al, which demonstrated significant cross-sectional associations between heart rate variability (HRV) indices, depressive symptoms, and lung function in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). Building on these findings, we further explore the underlying mechanisms, particularly inflammatory-autonomic-oxidative stress pathways, as key causal mediators.

pmc-12735802.title: Therapeutic Evaluation of Rosmarinic Acid in a Rat Model Combining Hypertension, Diabetes, and Nephrolithiasis
pmc-12735802.creator: Anelise Felício Macarini, Mariana Zanovello, Anelize Dada, Rita de Cássia Vilhena da Silva, Rogério Corrêa, Priscila de Souza, Haixia Chen
pmc-12735802.description: Background: Cardiometabolic disorders such as hypertension and diabetes are major contributors to chronic kidney disease and often coexist, amplifying dysfunction and metabolic imbalance that favor renal injury and nephrolithiasis. Although pharmacological therapies exist for blood pressure and glycemic control, few target these mechanisms simultaneously.

pmc-13272571.title: Comparative outcomes of medial and lateral plating for distal third tibial fractures: A systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13272571.creator: MC Bharath, H Nagaraju, Elstin Anbu Raj S, Kiran Kumar Vedavyasa Acharya, Divya Balan
pmc-13272571.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundDistal third tibial fractures pose significant surgical challenges due to minimal soft-tissue coverage and a high risk of wound complications. Although both medial and lateral plating techniques are commonly used for fixation, the best surgical approach remains debated. This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to compare the clinical outcomes and complication rates of medial and lateral plating for distal third tibial fractures.MethodsThe study protocol was first registered in PROSPERO (CRD42025644545).

pmc-13416126.title: Characterization of resistance to rice root-knot nematode Meloidogyne graminicola in an indica rice land race Aganni: insights on pre and post infection defence responses
pmc-13416126.creator: Nethi Somasekhar, Satish Namdeo Chavan, D Sanjeeva Rao, P Senguttuvel, S V Sai Prasad, Raman Meenakshi Sundaram
pmc-13416126.description: The rice root-knot nematode Meloidogyne graminicola is one of the important biotic constraints limiting rice production in many rice growing areas of the world, especially in aerobic and direct seeded conditions. Controlling M. graminicola using traditional management methods is challenging. Identification of rice genotypes resistant to M. graminicola is crucial for developing effective and sustainable nematode management strategies.

pmc-13454087.title: Decoupling Ion–Dipole Interactions via Competitive Coordination for Durable Dendrite-Free Zinc Metal Batteries
pmc-13454087.creator: Bixian Chen, Xiaomin Cheng, Xiang Li, Qinghua Guan, Hao Li, Yongzheng Zhang, Shuang Cheng, Huihua Li, Yunjian Liu, Jing Zhang, Hongzhen Lin, Jian Wang
pmc-13454087.description: Highlights A competitive permanent dipole L-Carnosine (L-CN) is introduced to interact with Zn2+ in the Zn2+–H2O solvation shell and form Zn2+(L-CN)y(H2O)x structure, enhancing the desolvation kinetics of [Zn(H2O)6]2+ and diffusion kinetics of zinc ions/atoms.The L-CN molecule forms a crowded Zn2+-conductive structure and remodels the inner Helmholtz plane layer with abundant Zn2+ flux, enabling durable dendrite-free Zn deposition.

pmc-13578529.title: Performance of Free‐Running Cardiac and Respiratory Motion‐Resolved Whole‐Heart 5D MRI in Congenital Heart Disease Patients Using a Gadolinium Enhanced Fast‐Interrupted Steady‐State Sequence
pmc-13578529.creator: Christopher W. Roy, Eva Vogeli, Alissia Megalo, Fabienne Dirbach, Jessica A. M. Bastiaansen, Jérôme Yerly, Marco Mueller, David Rodrigues, Jean‐Baptiste Ledoux, Juerg Schwitter, Milan Prša, Estelle Tenisch, Tobias Rutz, Matthias Stuber

pmc-13615024.title: High-frequency pseudo-hypofunction of the superior semicircular canal dehiscence syndrome: a vHIT – oVEMP dissociation explained by hydrodynamic energy loss
pmc-13615024.creator: Leonardo Manzari, Nicola Ferri, Marco Tramontano
pmc-13615024.description: BackgroundSuperior semicircular canal dehiscence syndrome (SCDS) produces a wide spectrum of vestibular and auditory abnormalities due to the presence of a “third mobile window.” While enhanced otolith-mediated responses are well recognized, the behavior of high-frequency semicircular canal function remains debated. Many patients show reduced superior canal vestibulo-oculomotor reflex (VOR) gains despite preserved or exaggerated utricular responses.
